# SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE 4: REGRESSION OF COLIBACTIN MUTAGENESIS VERSUS AGE:

```{r}
library(ggh4x)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
```

```{r}
crypt_signature_attributions<-read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')
crypt_metadata<-read.csv('../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv')
```
## a : perform regrssion of age versus colibactin mutational burden
```{r}
# construct a dataframe for regression models
colibactin_burdens_regressions_df<-left_join(crypt_metadata,crypt_signature_attributions,by=c('biopsy','patient'))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>%
  filter(SBS88>0 & ID18>0)%>%
  dplyr::select(patient,site,location,SBS88,ID18,age)

# run mixed effects regression for SBS88 and ID18
models_df <- colibactin_burdens_regressions_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(SBS88, ID18),names_to = "mut_type", values_to = "burden") %>%
  group_by(mut_type) %>%
  summarise(model = list(lmer(burden ~ age  + site+(1 | patient), data = cur_data())), .groups = "drop")

# construct a dataframe with the model outputs
regression_df <- models_df %>%
  mutate(coef = purrr::map(model, ~ broom.mixed::tidy(.x, effects = "fixed"))) %>%
  unnest(coef) %>%
  filter(term %in% c("(Intercept)", "age")) %>%
  dplyr::select(mut_type, term, estimate, std.error,p.value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = c(estimate, std.error,p.value)) %>%
  transmute(
    models = mut_type, intercept = `estimate_(Intercept)`, slope     = estimate_age, intercept_low_ci = intercept - 1.96 * `std.error_(Intercept)`,
    intercept_upp_ci = intercept + 1.96 * `std.error_(Intercept)`, slope_low_ci     = slope - 1.96 * std.error_age, slope_upper_ci   = slope + 1.96 * std.error_age,
    p.value=p.value_age)

# construct a dataframe to facilitate the ribbon and geom line
age_grid <- seq(0, 20, length.out = 100)

regression_df_expanded <- regression_df %>%
  tidyr::crossing(age = age_grid) %>%
  mutate(fit = intercept + slope * age, lwr = intercept_low_ci + slope_low_ci * age, upr = intercept_upp_ci + slope_upper_ci * age)

regression_df_expanded$mut_type <- factor(
  regression_df_expanded$models, levels = c("SBS88", "ID18"))

```

print the output from modelling:
```{r}
print(regression_df)
```

## b : plot regrssion of age versus colibactin mutational burden
```{r}
## plot association of colibactin mutagenesis versus time
# construct a dataframe for plotting:
colibactin_burdens_plot_df<-left_join(crypt_metadata,crypt_signature_attributions,by=c('biopsy','patient'))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>%
  filter(SBS88>0 & ID18>0)%>%
  dplyr::select(biopsy,site,SBS88,ID18,age)%>%
  gather(mut_type, counts, -biopsy, -site,-age)%>%
  group_by(site,biopsy,mut_type)%>%
  summarise(median=median(counts,na.rm=T),
            lower=quantile(counts,0.25,na.rm=T),
            upper=quantile(counts,0.75,na.rm=T),
            age=median(age))%>%
  mutate(mut_type=factor(mut_type,levels=c('SBS88','ID18')))
```

## b : plot the association of age and colibactin mutation burden
```{r}
plt <- ggplot(data = colibactin_burdens_plot_df, aes(x = age, y = median)) +
  geom_ribbon( data = regression_df_expanded, aes(x = age, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = regression_df_expanded, aes(x = age, y = fit, linetype = "Mutation Burden ~ Age"), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),size = 1, width = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(aes(col = site), size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~mut_type, scales = "free", label = labeller(mut_type = as_labeller(c(SBS88 = "SBS 88 Burden", ID18 = "ID 18 Burden")))) +
  facetted_pos_scales(y = list(mut_type == "SBS88" ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2250)), 
                               TRUE ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 400)))) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(Left = "maroon4", Right = "maroon3"),
    breaks = c("Left", "Right"),
    labels = c("Left Sided Colon", "Right Sided Colon")
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Mutation Burden ~ Age" = "dashed"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 20)) +
  labs(
    x = "Donor Age at Biopsy [years]",
    y = "Mutation Burden",
    col = "Biopsy Site"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", colour = "grey20"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )
ggsave('/Users/hm14/Downloads//colibactin_age_burdens.png',plt,width=12,height=7, dpi=300)

```
